programmes.d: In preparation for a role, a world-renowned actress shadows the NCIS team as they investigate a decapitation case.
Parker grapples with his emotions when a con man from his past turns up as a prime suspect in the murder of a navy officer.
NCIS investigates the death of a ride-share driver who was found after a car accident; Parker's dad, who is temporarily living with him, assists the team in their investigation.
The NCIS team jumps into motion to investigate who is responsible for a potential bioterror attack at a strip mall parking garage; Knight's father deals with a health scare while in Japan.

NCIS works to solve the murder of a Marine private who appears to have been killed for helping an Afghan refugee; Jimmy navigates the pressure of parenting his teenage daughter, who is eager to go out on an unchaperoned group date.
The NCIS team digs deep to investigate a Navy lieutenant who's accused of trying to murder her husband but has no memory of the attack; Kasie navigates a potential medical scare.
Agent Knight goes viral for saving a mother and child from a potentially fatal car accident.
NCIS works to solve the murder of a senator's daughter who has a rebellious reputation and large online following; Jimmy gets competitive with an old college rival.
NCIS must investigate a string of Russian spy encounters that may be linked to a suspicious murder; Jimmy accidentally makes a confession that could change the course of his relationship with Knight.
Agent Torres finds himself in prison as the team tries to stop an impending terror attack on U.S. soil.

McGee and Torres try to recover a stolen truck filled with toys for the Navy's annual Christmas drive; the truth about Parker's mother is finally revealed; Knight is tasked with tracking down a former member of the team.
Knight is given orders to hunt down and arrest Eleanor Bishop after the former member of the NCIS team is designated a wanted cyberterrorist.

When a desperate man barricades himself inside an ammo warehouse, Knight is the only negotiator he'll talk to, claiming she once saved him before; as explosives tick and trust frays, Knight clashes with the CID officer running the standoff.
A murdered drone pilot leads the team to a missing woman from McGee's past and a relationship he thought was long behind him.
The NCIS team must help Torres when he puts his future at stake by confronting the man who tormented his family when he was a child.
As NCIS mourns the loss of Ducky, the agents find comfort in working on one of his unfinished cases involving a woman whose father was dishonorably discharged from the Marines.
When the NCIS team engages in Walk-a-Mile day to gain a new perspective on different departments, things take a turn when Kasie receives a distress call from a mysterious man.
The NCIS team races against time to find a missing officer who disappears during his wedding proposal.
A serial killer imitates a past murderer; while on maternity leave, Michelle must return to the IIB in order to save her reputation.
A former IIB colleague returns and ends up jeopardizing the team's success.
After a tip about a dance company, the team investigates the abduction of a ballerina.

With the help of Knight's dad, special agent Feng Zhao, NCIS works to unravel the mystery of a recently used service weapon belonging to a missing agent; McGee is in a tailspin when DNA results reveal a close relative he was unaware of.
After discovering a Navy pilot's body riddled with unusual wounds, NCIS' investigation draws the team into the rabbit hole of UFO conspiracy theories.

NCIS comes under attack by a mysterious enemy from the past; Vance tries to mend fences with his estranged son by explaining why, despite the ongoing dangers of his job, he still chooses to stay at NCIS.
The NCIS team looks for a motive behind the kidnapping and death of a famous heart surgeon.
